# On-screen caption style

**How do the burned-in captions look, if there are any?** · [all approaches](index.md) · clashes: C4, C29


## Word by word, key word in a coloured box
<a id="word-highlight-box"></a>

One word or phrase at a time; the key word sits in a coloured highlight box.

**Looks like:** White bold words flip every 0.3–0.5 s and 'speed.' lands inside a red box. The eye locks onto the box each time.

**Good at:** retention; emphasis; accessibility; sound-off viewing

**Weak at:** busy; 'lose the green box' (L10) says it looks less clean

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, reel90, yt-short · niches all · goals retention, reach · effort medium

**How:** CapCut auto-captions with the highlight template, or faster-whisper timings into HyperFrames captions.

**Backed by:** [Word-by-word captions, key word highlighted](../topics/text.md#text-word-by-word-highlight), [Word-level transcription for captions and cuts](../topics/ai-tools.md#ai-word-level-transcription), [Plain shadowed captions, no box](../topics/text.md#l10-plain-shadow-captions), [Uppercase caption bar between halves](../topics/text.md#text-uppercase-caption-bar) · sources L03, R1

## Plain white with soft shadow, no box
<a id="plain-shadow"></a>

White bold sans, soft drop shadow, 1–3 words, no background box.

**Looks like:** Small clean words sit just above the lower third, at about 61% height. They read easily without fighting the picture, and one coral box appears only for a special word.

**Good at:** premium feel; clean; lets the image breathe

**Weak at:** less emphasis; can vanish on bright footage

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, reel90, yt-short · niches all · goals trust, retention · effort low

**How:** Edits/CapCut captions with the box off and a shadow on; HyperFrames text-shadow for custom builds.

**Backed by:** [Plain shadowed captions, no box](../topics/text.md#l10-plain-shadow-captions), [Teaching text: clean sans, red/green](../topics/text.md#text-clean-sans-teaching), [Uppercase caption bar between halves](../topics/text.md#text-uppercase-caption-bar), [Word-by-word captions, key word highlighted](../topics/text.md#text-word-by-word-highlight) · sources L10

## Uppercase caption bar between halves
<a id="caption-bar"></a>

Uppercase bold white captions, 3–4 words, placed on the seam of a split screen.

**Looks like:** Face on top, step board below, and a strip of caps words running across the middle. The eye sits where both halves meet.

**Good at:** split-screen layouts; readability; ties the halves together

**Weak at:** only suits split layouts; shouty

**Best for:** formats reel60, reel90, yt-short · niches tech, all · goals retention · effort low

**How:** Caption track positioned at the split line in CapCut, all caps, 3–4 words per card.

**Backed by:** [Uppercase caption bar between halves](../topics/text.md#text-uppercase-caption-bar), [Plain shadowed captions, no box](../topics/text.md#l10-plain-shadow-captions), [Word-by-word captions, key word highlighted](../topics/text.md#text-word-by-word-highlight), [Subtle 105–110% punch-in on key phrases](../topics/effects.md#fx-subtle-punch-in) · sources L04

## Custom kinetic text (not captions)
<a id="kinetic-custom"></a>

Only key words animate in as designed type with glow, scale pops and tracking, instead of full captions.

**Looks like:** '$100,000/MONTH' slams in with a glow and a bass hit, then 'WHY' alone. Most words are not written; the important ones are big.

**Good at:** premium, cinematic; emphasis; teasers

**Weak at:** not accessible; slow to build; unclear for sound-off viewers

**Best for:** formats reel30, yt-short, yt-long · niches all · goals reach, retention · effort high

**How:** HyperFrames kinetic type blocks, or CapCut text with keyframed scale and glow.

**Backed by:** [Kinetic type: float-ins, glow, pop-ins](../topics/effects.md#fx-kinetic-words), [Script + heavy extruded sans pairing](../topics/text.md#text-script-plus-heavy-sans), [Keywords in caption and text over hashtags](../topics/text.md#text-seo-over-hashtags), [Word-by-word captions, key word highlighted](../topics/text.md#text-word-by-word-highlight), [Make motion visible with a dotted trail](../topics/effects.md#fx-trail-visual-proof) · sources L08, L07

## No burned captions, title only
<a id="none-title-only"></a>

No captions on the body; a title card carries the topic. Oren's own long form does this.

**Looks like:** A clean talking shot with a yellow serif section title when each part starts. Nothing scrolls along the bottom.

**Good at:** clean long form; speed; cinematic

**Weak at:** sound-off viewers lose it; Oren recommends captions for almost everybody in short form

**Best for:** formats yt-long, podcast · niches all · goals trust, speed · effort low

**How:** Title cards only; YouTube's closed captions for accessibility.

**Backed by:** [Captions on yaps for almost everybody](../topics/text.md#text-captions-on-yaps), [Yellow bold serif section titles](../topics/text.md#text-yellow-serif-section-titles), [Plain shadowed captions, no box](../topics/text.md#l10-plain-shadow-captions), [Keywords in caption and text over hashtags](../topics/text.md#text-seo-over-hashtags), [Text behind your head](../topics/effects.md#l10-text-behind-head) · sources L06

## Mixing
L10 uses plain captions with one box moment. Kinetic key words can sit over plain captions. Short form with captions and long form without is the reading C4 offers.

## Rule of thumb
Retention-first short form: highlight box. Premium or clean look: plain shadow. Split layouts: caption bar. Teasers: kinetic. Long form: title only.
